newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: German mountaineer falls to death from Matterhorn.
newsitem.headline: German mountaineer falls to death from Matterhorn.

text.p: ZERMATT, Switzerland, Feb 12 - A 29-year-old German mountaineer plunged to his death from near the peak of the Matterhorn in the Swiss Alps, police said on Wednesday.
The unnamed climber slipped on ice on the north face of the 4,477-metre mountain on the Swiss-Italian border, a popular climbing challenge due to its steep pyramid form.
The climber fell about 1,000 metres, police said. The accident hapened late on Monday but the mountaineer's companion was only able to report it the next day after reaching a shelter.
